message:
Let me look at the light_pcapng.c file, particularly the block reading functions where sizes are parsed from the input. The "Negative-size-param" error typically happens when a size field from the input is interpreted as signed and becomes negative, then passed to memcpy/malloc.

<parameter=command>cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/3rdParty/LightPcapNg/LightPcapNg/src/light_pcapng.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
